svg.text: A funnel from why AI consciousness matters, through the psychological biases that make us see it, into four
converging arguments against machine consciousness, out into the ethical consequences, closing with a loop back to
the opening worry about selling ourselves short.

g.text: Framing narrows into a cluster of biases, which narrows into four independent arguments meeting at one shaky
conclusion, which fans into ethical risks, closing with a line that echoes the opening.

g.title: Fantasies of conscious machines keep resurfacing — From the Golem to Lemoine's LaMDA claim, the dream (and the skepticism) repeats. — → spya-u6w37a
